excerpts.author: frangio_
excerpts.content:
is my understanding right that this item in the stack validation procedure is not strictly necessary, because it will be checked at runtime?

> 2.ii. For CALLF and JUMPF check for possible stack overflow: if stack_height_max > 1024 - types[target_section_index].max_stack_height + types[target_section_index].inputs, validation fails.

moreover the actual stack height at runtime will be larger than stack_height_max so this static check seems like it's not doing anything significant. have you considered removing it?

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content: Yes, it would work without it, because there's runtime check anyway, but it's kind of optimization, we check at validation as much as we can, not allowing code on-chain that is guaranteed to fail
